h1: The 6 Best Self-Cleaning Robot Vacuum Mops of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Self-Cleaning Robot Vacuum Mops: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 6 robot vacuum mops with self-cleaning docks, from roborock and iRobot to Shark and eufy, scored on pad washing and upkeep.
summary: The roborock Qrevo S5V is the self-cleaning mop to buy for hard floors because its FlexiArm reaches the baseboards that most pads skip. The iRobot Roomba 505X is the one for owners who hate musty pads: it rinses, then hot-dries them. The eufy C28 uses a roller mop that gets flushed at the dock, and the Shark Matrix Plus is the cheaper way into a self-cleaning dock. If a washing dock is out of budget, the Tikom at least empties itself.
intro: Self-cleaning means different things on different boxes. For some it is a dock that rinses the mop pad. For others it is a dock that only empties the dust bin, and the mop is still yours to wash. The difference is the whole reason to pay extra, because a damp pad left to sit smells within a day or two.

We reviewed models on that distinction first: does the dock wash the mop, dry it, and handle the bin? Then we looked at mop style, suction and price. Four of the six here truly self-clean the mop, and two are included as honest fallbacks, clearly marked. Rankings come from spec sheets and owner reports, not from running the machines.

products.name: roborock Qrevo S5V Robot Vacuum and Mop, FlexiArm Edge Mopping
products.verdict: A self-cleaning dock plus a mop arm that reaches the edges.
products.description:
The Qrevo S5V is a vacuum and mop combo on roborock's premium platform with a self-cleaning dock and FlexiArm edge mopping. The arm extends a pad toward baseboards, so the mop covers the edges that a fixed pad leaves dirty.

It takes first place because it fixes both complaints at once: the dock handles the mop's cleanliness, and the arm handles reach. The Roomba 505X below beats it on drying, but the S5V is the better mopper.

Best for hard floors with a lot of baseboard. Caveat: it is priced near the top of the roundup.
products.idealFor: Hard floors with plenty of baseboard.

products.name: iRobot Roomba 505X Robot Vacuum & Mop Combo
products.verdict: The dock rinses the pads and finishes with a hot-dry cycle.
products.description:
The 505X pairs spinning mop pads with a multifunction dock that self-empties for up to 75 days, rinses the pads and finishes with a hot-dry cycle. The pads also lift when the robot reaches carpet.

It ranks second because drying is the feature most likely to stop a damp, musty pad, and the S5V does not list it. In exchange it has no edge arm, so baseboards are less thoroughly covered.

Best for homes where pad odor is the complaint. Caveat: pricey, and the dock is bulky.

products.name: eufy C28 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo, 15,000 Pa, HydroJet Roller Mop
products.verdict: A roller mop with a self-washing dock and 15,000Pa suction.
products.description:
The C28 uses a HydroJet roller mop instead of a pad, and the dock washes the roller between cycles. It lists a high-power vacuum motor with 15,000Pa suction.

It ranks third because the roller does not reach into edges like the S5V's arm, and it lacks the hot-dry step of the 505X. Against the Shark Matrix Plus, it adds suction and a roller that sheds grime well.

Best for sticky floors in a family kitchen. Caveat: the roller still needs occasional checks.
pros: Roller mop washed at the dock

products.name: Shark Matrix Plus 2-in-1 Robot Vacuum & Mop, AV2613WA
products.verdict: A 2-in-1 that empties its bin and rinses its pad at the dock.
products.description:
The Matrix Plus vacuums and mops in one pass, then returns to a self-cleaning dock that handles auto dirt disposal. Shark's Matrix navigation is meant to catch corners and edges.

It ranks fourth because it costs far less than the three above but offers less on drying and edge reach. It is the easiest way to get a self-cleaning dock for under $300.

Best for a mid-budget buyer who wants the dock to do the work. Caveat: fewer spec details on the mop itself.
products.idealFor: Mid-budget homes wanting a washing dock.
products.skipIf: You want the best mop reach.

products.name: Tikom Robot Vacuum and Mop, Robotic Vacuum Cleaner with Self-Emptying Base
products.verdict: A self-emptying base at a mid price, but you still wash the pad yourself.
products.description:
The Tikom is a vacuum and mop combo with a self-emptying base and app control. To be clear, the base handles the dust bin, not the mop, so this is only half self-cleaning.

It ranks fifth because the four above wash the mop, and this does not. It is included as the budget step for readers who want the bin chore gone.

Best for a household that vacuums more than it mops. Caveat: expect to rinse the pad by hand.
cons: Mop is not washed by the dock
products.idealFor: Homes that vacuum often and mop occasionally.
products.skipIf: You want the mop cleaned automatically.

products.name: roborock Q7 L5 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo, 8,000Pa Suction
products.verdict: Not self-cleaning, but the cheapest roborock combo with 8,000Pa.
products.description:
The Q7 L5 combines vacuum and mop at a budget price, with 8,000Pa of suction and roborock's navigation. It does not come with a self-emptying or self-washing dock.

It is here as the honest fallback: if a washing dock is out of budget, a cheap roborock is better than a bad dock. It ranks last because everything above it automates upkeep.

Best for a small home on a strict budget. Caveat: you will empty the bin and wash the pad yourself.
products.idealFor: Small homes on a strict budget.
products.skipIf: Automation is the point of your purchase.

whatMatters.factor: Does the dock wash the mop?
whatMatters.detail: A dock that empties the bin is not the same as one that washes the mop. Self-emptying only removes dust. A washing dock rinses pads or a roller with fresh water and drains the dirty water into a tank. Look for the words washing, self-cleaning or mop wash in the bullets.
A wet pad sitting in a closed dock grows a musty smell in a day or two. Hot-air drying prevents it. If the listing does not mention drying, plan to remove the pad now and then.
A washing dock has a clean-water tank and a dirty-water tank. A small tank means refilling every few runs. Check the capacity and compare it to how often you mop.
Mop pads should lift when the robot reaches carpet. Listings mention lifting pads or carpet detection, as the Roomba 505X does. Without it, set no-mop zones.
Washing docks are large, roughly the size of a small bin, and need space on each side for the robot to dock. Measure the spot near an outlet before ordering.

cards.text: A dock that washes the mop and drains it, a long self-empty window for hair, and a drying step to keep odor down.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The Roomba 505X rinses and hot-dries pads and self-empties for up to 75 days, which is the best answer to pet odor here.

faq.q: What does self-cleaning mean on a robot mop?
faq.a: Usually that the dock washes the pad or roller with water. Some listings use it for bin emptying, so check, as with the Tikom, which only empties the bin.

faq.q: Do self-cleaning mops get rid of odor?
faq.a: Washing helps, but drying matters more. The Roomba 505X adds a hot-dry cycle, which is the feature aimed at odor.

faq.q: Is the roborock Qrevo S5V worth more than the Shark Matrix Plus?
faq.a: If you care about edges, yes: the FlexiArm reaches baseboards. For ordinary floors the Shark is cheaper and still washes at the dock.

faq.q: How often do I refill the dock tank?
faq.a: It depends on tank size and how often you mop. Check the capacity in the specs and plan on a refill every few runs.

faq.q: Can self-cleaning mops go on carpet?
faq.a: They should lift the pad first. The Roomba 505X lists lifting pads, and others use no-mop zones in the app.

faq.q: Do I still need to clean the dock?
faq.a: Yes. Rinse the dirty-water tank and wipe the wash tray every week or two to keep smells away.

finalTake: For most buyers who want a robot mop that cleans up after itself, the roborock Qrevo S5V is the best choice, with a self-cleaning dock and an arm that reaches edges. The Roomba 505X wins if odor is the worry, and the eufy C28 handles sticky floors. If budget is tight, the Shark Matrix Plus is the sensible compromise, and the Tikom and Q7 L5 are fallbacks that leave the mop to you.
